0022600020.text: The Pacers (2-3) come in on a two-game losing streak, 0-2 at home and 2-1 on the road, and sit 9th in the East and 3rd in the Central, 2 games back. The Heat (1-4) are 0-3 at home, have won their last game, and are 14th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, also 2 games back. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Miami is without Simone Fontecchio (illness). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Pacers won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 135-118 win in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
